requirement.fact: {requirements_reuben} asked for a formal review of the feature store before any model is trained on it.

speaker.name: Requirements Reuben
speaker.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

output.objection: You are not asking for a formal gate on the feature store, you are just hoping the data looks clean. That is not the compliance posture I am asking for.
output.correction: I meant a strict sign off before any training job can start, not a casual check. The model must only see data that has passed my security review.
